FAQ

BMW Service FAQs

Can I book BMW service online?

Yes. Submit the vehicle details and choose your preferred location and date. Our team will review the request and contact you to confirm.

Can I request BMW spare parts?

Submit the VIN and part details through the spare-parts page. Our team will review compatibility and availability before contacting you.

Where is BMW service available?

Service can be requested at Fifth Settlement, Third Settlement and Sheikh Zayed, subject to vehicle review and availability.
